headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 26, 2026 — 2 PM Pacific
body: Nicki Minaj urged young voters to vote red ahead of the midterms. Kendrick Lamar's Grand National run with SZA was newly reported as a record-setting rap tour. Blueface was sued over an alleged livestream of Chrisean Rock's PPV boxing debut. Snoop Dogg is set to host the 2026 MTV VMAs in Los Angeles. Grand Theft Auto VI is Game Informer's next cover story with a 14-page Rockstar package and 12 new screenshots.
caption:
1. Nicki Minaj is urging young voters to “vote red” ahead of the midterms and said Democrats are too caught up in pop culture. Her remarks came in a Fox News interview preview, putting @NICKIMINAJ back in the middle of the politics-and-pop conversation.

2. Kendrick Lamar’s Grand National run with SZA is being reported as the highest-grossing rap tour in history, with the final numbers still being discussed across trade and industry reports. The result matters because it turns a blockbuster live era into a new benchmark for rap’s touring power. @KENDRICKLAMAR

3. Blueface is facing a federal copyright suit after allegedly livestreaming Chrisean Rock’s pay-per-view boxing debut to thousands of viewers on Kick. The complaint says the stream ran for more than an hour and seeks damages over the claimed lost PPV revenue; it is an allegation, not a judgment. @BLUEFACEDABABY

4. Snoop Dogg hosts the 2026 MTV VMAs live from Los Angeles on Sept. 27, with the ceremony airing on CBS, MTV and Paramount+. The West Coast return gives the longtime VMAs veteran a full-circle stage as the show heads into its first Los Angeles edition since 2017. @SNOOPDOGG

5. Grand Theft Auto VI is the cover story for Game Informer’s next issue, with a 14-page Rockstar package and 12 new screenshots arriving digitally Sept. 29. The preview spotlights Leonida’s weather, wildlife and Florida detail ahead of the Nov. 19 launch. @ROCKSTARGAMES

@Rapwire247
threads_text: Nicki Minaj's pre-midterm remarks; Kendrick Lamar's reported touring record; Blueface's copyright suit over an alleged PPV livestream; Snoop Dogg hosting the VMAs; and GTA VI's Game Informer cover package. @Rapwire247
